Hi Dylan,

Attaching our latest signature matrix – ask from procurement as we kick Ariba enrollment. Two quick items we need to lock down before the portal activation:

1) Who is expected to sign the Order Form on Redwood's side? Our legal/finance team needs to map internal approval levels (SVP Finance vs. Head Legal vs. CEO).

2) PO acknowledgment SLA: Ariba expects an ACK window in the vendor setup. Procurement is asking if Redwood can commit to 48 hours for PO acknowledgements once the journey is live. If you need runway, tell us the target.

Also attaching a contact for our Ariba team if you need to share SFTP/EDI details: ariba-onboard@meditech.com.

Sam — thanks for the matrix and the head's up. Looping in Marissa (onboarding), Laura (legal) and Karthik (platform) so we can document the exact gating items. Quick responses inline below.

> Who signs the Order Form?
Our standard is countersigned by Head of Legal + VP Finance for commercial deals of this size. We can accept Danielle Ross as the Meditech signee; please confirm her title and signatory authority in the matrix (name, title, email). Laura: any objections to that flow?

> PO ACK SLA
We aim for 72 hours for PO acknowledgement by default. For customers who require it (and on Dedicated capacity) we can commit to 48 hours after onboarding completes. For Ariba enrollment specifically we can set the portal to expect 48 hours ACK but recommend a 2-week ramp where we tolerate up to 72 hours while tooling and EDI mapping stabilizes.

Action items:
- Marissa: coordinate Ariba preflight with Sam + ariba-onboard, get SFTP/PO XML schema.
- Karthik/Rishi: confirm if any PO field mappings would block the ACK automation (line-level SKU vs free-text).
- Laura: I attached an annotated draft of the Order Form with the acceptance clause and signature block we normally use. Please redline.

Attaching: Redwood_OrderForm_202611-annotated.pdf (pdf).

Dylan / Sam — I reviewed the annotated order form. High-level legal notes (please treat as redline requests rather than blockers):

- Signature authority: please include a line in the signature matrix confirming signatory authority ("authorized to bind the entity") and attach a copy of the board resolution or delegation if Danielle's signature is conditional by threshold. That will speed countersignature.

- PO acknowledgement clause: propose the following narrow change to the Order Form:
  "Vendor's acknowledgment of a Purchase Order constitutes acceptance of the PO solely for the goods/services described and prices specified. Any modifications to price, scope, or delivery shall be made only by a written amendment signed by authorized signatories of both parties."
This prevents inadvertent acceptance of unilateral changes embedded in PO footers.

- Acceptance window: we can accept the 48-hour ACK as negotiated, but require a 72-hour fallback for the first 14 days post-activation while EDI mappings are validated. Please capture that in the Ariba onboarding checklist.

I'll prepare a tracked-redline on the Order Form and upload to DocuSign when we have the final signatory confirmed.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Legal
